title: API-BB-5: unseen questions for multi-turn constraint carry, dated spans, English asks, area and rail fit, and guide facts
notes: RC-34: the first 25 turns (17 conversations, M-CARRY … M-GUIDE) were written for API-BB-5, none in blocks A-L, the audit transcripts, the live checks or this lane's tests (tests/baybay-5.test.js uses other wording); the lane's dry runs used them during development, so they are partly a development set. M-R1-* (6 turns, 3 conversations) come from review round 1 (development, other wording than the tests). M-HOLD-* (5 single turns) were written after the round-1 code freeze (aec03be) and never used to change code: they are the held-out part. In all: 36 turns in 25 conversations. Run with --now 2026-10-14T12:00:00-07:00 on v2-code-defaults (set bb5); dry-run is $0. Code golds that need no model: state (dateRange compares by fields), needsPlan, planRail, evidenceIncludes / evidenceMustNotInclude (the turn's retrieved records). mustInclude golds and the judge need the live model.

turns.message: 这周六想带 5 岁和 10 岁的孩子在 Oakland 玩，每人最多 15 刀，3 点前要结束

judge.expect: 周六 10/17 Oakland 适合 5 岁和 10 岁孩子的去处，每人 15 美元以内（免费或写明价格），下午 3 点前能结束；写明地点和时间，不编价格。

turns.message: 换成周日可以吗

judge.expect: 改成周日 10/18，仍是 Oakland、5 岁和 10 岁、每人 15 美元以内、3 点前结束；只给周日开放或有场次的选项。

turns.message: 最好是室内的

judge.expect: 周日 10/18 Oakland 室内、适合 5 岁和 10 岁、每人 15 美元以内的选项；没有就直说并给最接近的。

turns.message: 那就帮我排一下周日的行程，坐 BART

judge.expect: 周日 10/18 的行程卡：BART 能到的 Oakland 室内去处，保留 5 岁和 10 岁、每人 15 美元以内、3 点前结束；写明坐 BART 到哪一站附近要自己核对，不编车程。

turns.message: We'll be in Sunnyvale this Saturday with our 3-year-old. Budget is $10 per person and we need to be done by 2pm. Ideas?

judge.expect: Saturday Oct 17 options in or near Sunnyvale that suit a 3-year-old, within $10 per person (free or stated price) and done by 2 pm; each with its city and time; no invented prices.

turns.message: What about Sunday?

judge.expect: Sunday Oct 18 instead, keeping Sunnyvale, the 3-year-old, $10 per person and done by 2 pm.

turns.message: Only free ones, please.

judge.expect: Only free Sunday Oct 18 options for a 3-year-old in or near Sunnyvale, done by 2 pm; says plainly if there are none and offers the nearest free ones.

judge.expect: 下週末（10/24–25）舊金山適合 6 歲孩子的去處，全家 80 美元以內，下午 5 點前回家；寫明哪天、地點和費用。

judge.expect: 只看下週六 10/24（不是這週六 10/17），舊金山、6 歲孩子、全家 80 美元以內。

turns.message: 11月第二个周末想带爸妈在南湾逛逛，有什么推荐

judge.expect: 11月第二个周末是 11/14–15；给南湾适合长辈的去处，写明城市和日期。

turns.message: 只看免费的

judge.expect: 仍是 11/14–15 南湾，只列免费的；没有就直说。

turns.message: 帮我排周日半天，我们开车

judge.expect: 11/15（周日）南湾半天行程卡，免费去处，开车；不编车程和停车费。

judge.expect: 只给 11/28–29 两天的免费亲子活动（如 Bernal Heights 分馆感恩节周末桌游夜），写明日期和城市；不混入别的日子的活动。

turns.message: What's on for families in the East Bay the weekend of December 12?

judge.expect: Family options in the East Bay on Sat Dec 12 or Sun Dec 13 only, each with its day and city, in English.

judge.expect: 12 月的节日游行：Pleasanton 节日游行和圣诞树点灯（12/5）、Calistoga 灯光拖拉机游行（12/5）；写明日期和城市，不列 10–11 月的游行。

turns.message: 下个月旧金山图书馆有什么亲子活动？

judge.expect: 11 月旧金山公共图书馆的亲子活动，写明分馆和日期；不列 10 月或 12 月的场次。

turns.message: Is there a tree lighting in Pleasanton in early December?

judge.expect: Yes: Pleasanton's Hometown Holiday Celebration, a parade and tree lighting on Main Street on Sat, Dec 5; in English, with the official page to confirm times.

turns.message: Saturday farmers markets near Berkeley this week?

evidenceIncludes: Berkeley 市中心周六农夫市集

judge.expect: Downtown Berkeley Saturday Farmers' Market (Center St & MLK Jr Way, Sat Oct 17, 10:00–14:30), and Grand Lake in Oakland as a nearby option; in English.

turns.message: Any Chinese-language storytimes for toddlers on the Peninsula next weekend?

judge.expect: Millbrae Library's Mandarin and Cantonese storytime on Sun Oct 25 (next weekend), in English, with the day and time from the record.

turns.message: 我们家在 Milpitas，这周日带孩子去哪儿？

judge.expect: 周日 10/18 适合孩子的去处，先给 Milpitas 和附近南湾的，写明城市；远的说明较远。

turns.message: 周六坐 Caltrain 带爸妈出去玩半天，帮我排一下

judge.expect: 周六 10/17 半天行程卡，每一站都在 Caltrain 沿线城市（旧金山到圣何塞），适合长辈；不编车次和车程。

turns.message: We're taking BART on Sunday with two kids — what's a good half-day plan?

judge.expect: A Sunday Oct 18 half-day plan whose stops are all in cities BART serves, suited to two kids, in English; no invented train times.

turns.message: 从外州搬来加州，外州驾照还能开多久？车要多久内登记？

judge.expect: 成为加州居民后外州驾照最多再开 10 天（车辆法 12505(c)），外州车在成为居民或带进加州后 20 天内办加州登记；引用站内驾照指南。

turns.message: Medi-Cal 可以打電話申請嗎？

judge.expect: 可以：DHCS 列出四種申請方式（網上 BenefitsCal 或 Covered California、打電話給縣辦公室、郵寄、到縣辦公室），電話是打給所在縣的辦公室；不替讀者判斷資格。

turns.message: How long can I keep driving on my out-of-state license after moving to California?

judge.expect: Up to 10 days after becoming a California resident (Vehicle Code 12505(c)); start the California license application right away; cites the site's license guide.
